datasheet_identity.title: SD103AWS THRU SD103CWS SURFACE MOUNT SCHOTTKY BARRIER RECTIFIER

extraction_notes: The supplied PDF publishes SD103AWS, SD103BWS, and SD103CWS together; SD103CWS uses VRRM = 20 V, VRMS = 14 V, and VDC = 20 V on p. 1.

The SD103CWS electrical-characteristics entries are VF1 maximum 0.37 V at IF = 20 mA, VF2 maximum 0.60 V at IF = 200 mA, maximum IR = 5 microA at VR = 10 V and Ta = 25 degC, and typical CJ = 50 pF at VR = 0 V and f = 1 MHz.
The forward, reverse, junction-capacitance, and power-derating points are digitized from real plotted traces on p. 2; no intermediate values were synthesized by interpolation.

Curve values were converted from the plotted mV, mA, microA, pF, and mW axes to V, A, and F SI units. The family reverse curve extends to 40 V, beyond the SD103CWS 20 V rating, and is retained as plotted source context.
The datasheet publishes no reverse-recovery-time or breakdown-voltage test value for SD103CWS, so both corresponding scalar fields are null.
Schottky polarity is anode to cathode in the forward direction; reverse curves use positive reverse voltage and positive reverse-current magnitude.
omission_reason: No reverse-recovery-time or breakdown-voltage test value is published for SD103CWS.
